dependency_graph.assessment: The graph models only PyPI-level metadata for numpy: no declared runtime dependencies (consistent with numpy having none), 3056 direct reverse dependents including the core scientific stack (scipy, pandas, scikit-learn, matplotlib, numba). It does NOT contain the native/build graph (OpenBLAS via scipy-openblas64, Highway, meson-python, Cython, cibuildwheel); those come from pyproject.toml and the sw-ecosystem report and are not graph edges, so no transitive build graph was inferred. The graph does not express build/optional/test dependency kinds for numpy and no conflicts with the checkout were found, only omissions.

data.summary: numpy already ships riscv64 downstream via riseproject-dev/python-wheels (build-numpy.yml; 1.26.4-2.5.3 published, merged PRs #98/#99) and upstream has native riscv64 CI (linux_riscv64.yml, PR 31488) and Tier 3 status in NEP 57 (PR 31522). Official wheels require Tier 2: numpy-release forbids self-hosted runners and caching, so a riscv64 row there needs cross-compilation or a policy decision; rgommers invited a Tier 2 proposal on 2026-11-17.
